page.layout: Running head at top centre: "Ehrenpfort", with page number "200" at top left. Below it, a centred Roman numeral "III." followed by one row of three columns (Hadrianus / Trajanus / Nerva). Then centred "IV." with one row of three columns (Alexander / Severus / Antonius). Then a full-width paragraph in larger type. Then centred "V." with one row (Gordianus / Philippus / Decius), centred "VI." with one row (Aurelianus / Probus / Diocletianus), centred "VII." with one row (Constantinus / Valentinianus / Gratianus), centred "VIII." with one row (Theodosius / Arcadius / Honorius), centred "IX." with one row (Odacker / Dietrich von Bern / Anastasius), centred "X." with one row (Iustinianus / Heraclius / Carolus). Below the last row: at bottom left a signature mark "ɀ6", at bottom right the catchword "7. Ludo:". One page of text, no margin notes.

main_text.l: Hadrianus, der Sanfft. | Trajanus, der Beste. | Nerva, der Mitsam.
Alexander, der Sitsam. | Severus, der Ernstlich. | Antonius, der Gütig.
main_text.p: Dise Keyser vnd König werden neben der rechten Seul/ darauff oben Albrechte I. der Sieghafft/ vnnd vnden an S. Arnolff stehen/ abwarts in neun Feldern continuirt.
main_text.l: 1. Gordianus, der Hinleger. | Philippus, der erst Christlich Keyser. | Decius, der Behend.
2. Aurelianus, der Widerbringer. | Probus, der Fromm[?]. | Diocletianus, der Mächtig.
3. Constantinus, der Christliche. | Valentinianus, der Starcke. | Gratianus, der Begnadet.
4. Theodosius, der Gottsförchtig. | Arcadius, der Lieblich. | Honorius, der Wandelbar.
5. Odacker, der Heerführer. | Dietrich von Bern, Adl von Hispania. | Anastasius, der Vereiner.
6. Iustinianus, der Rechtsetzer. | Heraclius, Erfech-ter deß H. Creu- | Carolus, der Groß.

page.notes: Whole page set in black letter (Fraktur); no black-letter tags used, as the whole page is in that type. Roman numerals and bare numbers are written as paragraphs, not headings, per the rules. The table rows are given as one line each, with cells separated by " | ". The entry "Albrechte" is printed as such; the final e may be a printing error or a [?]-worthy form. "Fromm" under Probus has a doubtful abbreviation mark; read as "Fromm[?]". The bottom-left mark "ɀ6" is uncertain and is given as a signature with [?]. The hyphenated word "Creu-" at the end of the Heraclius line is printed without its continuation on this page; left as printed. The catchword "7. Ludo:" is taken as printed, including the number label.
